route_filename_evidence.public_disaster_relief_business_interrup: Campaign270 already terminalizes facility flood and physical-hazard exposure for lack of a point-in-time facility master, entity mapping, versioned hazard archive, public clock, spatial join and complete zero-exposure denominator; Campaign166 governs operational incidents and Campaign172 governs property, business-interruption and catastrophe insurance recovery.
route_filename_evidence.public_food_sanitation_grade_inspection_: Campaign215 already freezes restaurant, food-service and food-safety inspection, quarantine, discard, recall, corrective-action and waste lifecycle state; Campaign221 separately governs inspection and certification lifecycle.
route_filename_evidence.public_trade_quota_import_export_license: Campaign180 already freezes tariff-quota, origin, classification and preferential-eligibility state, while Campaign179 freezes scarce regulated quotas, licenses and entitlements.
route_filename_evidence.public_carbon_allowance_credit_issuance_: Campaign165 governs environmental emissions, energy and compliance state; Campaign220 freezes certificate issuance, transfer, retirement and cancellation lifecycle. Carbon allowance or credit labels do not create a new economic mechanism.
route_filename_evidence.public_academic_research_collaboration_p: Campaign167 governs issuer R&D and public operating milestone disclosure, Campaign183 governs technology transfer and licensing identity, and Campaign273 already rejects patent-citation diffusion as a patent/R&D metric variant.
route_filename_evidence.public_spectrum_numbering_route_slot_cap: Campaign179 explicitly freezes regulated spectrum, numbering, route, slot, service-area and capacity allocations, including transfer, renewal, suspension and withdrawal.
route_filename_evidence.public_corporate_charitable_donation_soc: No dedicated complete prior mechanism was found. Receiving government support is not the same issuer state as discretionary giving, but no admitted full-market point-in-time donation and relief source contract exists.

route_results.reason: Facility hazard, interruption, reopening and closure are already frozen by Campaign270 and Campaign166, while insured business-interruption recovery is frozen by Campaign172. Selecting another disaster, jurisdiction, support program, recovery stage or insurer would be a prohibited mechanism or source-family rescue.

Campaign215 already freezes food-safety inspection, violation, quarantine, discard, recall, corrective-action, closure and reopening state; Campaign221 governs generic inspection and certification. A sanitation grade, regulator, venue class or closure window is only a field or cohort variation.

Campaign180 already freezes tariff-rate quota, origin, classification and eligibility state, and Campaign179 freezes quotas, licenses and entitlements as scarce regulated allocations. Import/export direction, product class, utilization stage or jurisdiction cannot rescue the route.

Environmental compliance and emissions state are frozen by Campaign165, while issuance, allocation, transfer, surrender, retirement and cancellation form the certificate lifecycle already frozen by Campaign220. Carbon instruments are a commodity and jurisdiction variant of those terminal mechanisms.

Issuer research collaboration and publication are channels or metrics of the R&D milestone mechanism frozen by Campaign167 and the technology-transfer identity frozen by Campaign183; Campaign273 separately closes patent diffusion as an R&D metric variant. University role, project type, publication venue or citation window does not make the mechanism independent.

Campaign179 explicitly freezes spectrum, numbering, route, airport-slot, service-area and capacity allocations together with transfer, renewal, suspension and withdrawal. This route is an exact restatement, not a new mechanism.

Discretionary corporate giving is economically distinct from an issuer receiving a government subsidy, but the repository has no admitted 2019-2023 point-in-time contract covering listed issuers and material subsidiaries, recipients and campaigns, pledges and fulfillment, in-kind valuation, corrections and withdrawals, first-public timing and the full applicable-market zero/missing denominator. Selective press releases or current charity lists cannot supply historical truth.

decision.reason: Six routes duplicate immutable terminal mechanisms and the only economically distinct route lacks a complete lawful point-in-time source contract. The frozen priority rule therefore stops Campaign278 before formula, direction, source fields, rows or values.
decision.next_safe_work: Campaign279 may freeze a new genuinely independent finite concept-only catalog before targeted inventory. It must not rescue any Campaign278 or earlier route with a current snapshot, incomplete coverage, sibling source, entity role, jurisdiction, field, metric, window, threshold or direction.
